specification.title: A nested scope completes; then the outer transaction rolls back
steps: Start the outer transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API.
Write the marker `outer` through the framework's ordinary write API. The framework decides when it is sent: one with a unit of work may keep it pending.
Start a nested scope with the framework's nested-transaction (savepoint) API. Write the marker `inner` in it, and make sure that write was sent.
End the nested scope normally, so that its savepoint is released.
Raise an application error in the outer scope, so that the framework rolls the outer transaction back.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the API has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: A nested scope (a savepoint) that completed belongs to the outer transaction: when the outer transaction rolls back, the nested scope's writes are rolled back too.

execution.description: DSL.using(DataSource, SQLDialect.POSTGRES) and DSLContext.transaction. No TransactionProvider is installed, so Configuration.transactionProvider() supplies DefaultTransactionProvider, whose default nested flag is true. The callback uses the Configuration it is given. A nested scope is configuration.dsl().transaction, which DefaultTransactionProvider implements with Connection.setSavepoint. Isolation for TX-05.managed-serializable is the Isolation.SERIALIZABLE transaction property, applied by DefaultTransactionProvider.brace before setAutoCommit(false). The DataSource calls DriverManager.getConnection and closes that connection when jOOQ releases it. No pool. TX-03 is not run in this mode. TX-05.explicit-serializable is not run in this mode: transaction() does not return a handle.

configuration.sql: DSL table and field names, no generated catalog

execution.form: Outer transaction and a nested DSLContext.transaction, which DefaultTransactionProvider implements as a JDBC savepoint. JDBC mode uses Connection.setSavepoint on the same connection. The outer callback catches the nested failure and returns.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

knowledge: The caller knows that the nested scope completed, and that the outer transaction rolled back.

api_outcome.basis: DSLContext.transaction rethrew the exception raised inside the callback, so jOOQ rolled back
api_outcome.contract: jOOQ 3.21 manual, Transaction management: a callback that returns is an implicit commit, and an uncaught exception rolls the transactional scope back. DSLContext.transaction javadoc: a runtime exception thrown by the transactional logic indicates that a rollback has occurred, and a checked exception is wrapped in DataAccessException with the same meaning. DefaultTransactionProvider.commit calls Connection.commit when the savepoint stack is empty. Connection.commit() is void and does not return a command tag. DefaultTransactionProvider models a nested transaction() as a JDBC Savepoint. It does not open a second connection.
